chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Faḍl al-Wāsiṭī that he said:
I wrote to al-Riḍā عليه السلام: if the sun and the moon are eclipsed while I am riding and unable to dismount. So he عليه السلام wrote back to me: ‘Pray upon your mount which you are on.’
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if an eclipse occurs while riding and they cannot dismount?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat during an eclipse when a person is mounted and unable to dismount. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام instructs that the prayer should be performed on one’s mount in such a circumstance, showing accommodation in worship when there is inability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1528 - It is reported from Ali ibn al-Fadl al-Wasiti that He said:

"I wrote to Imam al-Ridha (as) asking about what to do if the sun or moon eclipses while I am riding and unable to dismount.
He (as) wrote back to me saying, 'Pray on your mount, whatever you are on.'".
